defects.catch_criteria: exhaustedProvidersCopy in src/infra/llm/provider-error-copy.ts appends the banked-reset hint only to `message`, but it always sets `detail`, and providerErrorProse in the same file returns `detail ?? message`, so workflow step failures and subagent failure summaries (formatAgentFailure) never carry the hint, contrary to the claim that the hint reaches the providerErrorProse registers. A review catches this when it says the hint is absent from the prose or detail path that workflow or subagent failures use.
defects.title: The banked-reset hint disappears from workflow and subagent failure prose
